measurementMetrics.durationMs: AWS REPORT Duration; primary AWS summary metric, not Java handlerMs
measurementMetrics.handlerMs: Java handler elapsed time; excludes initialization, framework decoding/serialization and log emission
measurementMetrics.s3Ms: Java elapsed time for full SDK GET, buffering and Content-Length validation
measurementMetrics.jsonMs: Java dataset JSON deserialization; null for io
measurementMetrics.cpuMs: Java elapsed calculation time for cpu or CRC32 time for io; not CPU utilization
measurementMetrics.billedMs: AWS REPORT Billed Duration; includes applicable initialization and rounding
measurementMetrics.callerMs: Python elapsed time including AWS CLI process, invocation and local response/log processing
